command:
sh -c '
export PATH="$PATH:/usr/local/sbin:/usr/sbin:/sbin"  # non-login SSH shells on RHEL 7 lack sbin
sec(){ printf '"'"'
@@%s@@
'"'"' "$1"; }
sec addrs; ip -o addr show 2>/dev/null | awk '"'"'{print $2, $3, $4}'"'"'
sec routes; ip route show default 2>/dev/null
sec listen; sudo -n sh -c '"'"'ss -Hltnup 2>/dev/null || ss -ltnup 2>/dev/null | tail -n +2'"'"' kanareika  || ss -Hltnu 2>/dev/null
sudo -n sh -c '"'"'printf '"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'
@@%s@@
'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"' firewalld_state; firewall-cmd --state 2>&1; printf '"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'
@@%s@@
'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"' firewalld; firewall-cmd --list-all-zones 2>/dev/null | head -n 400; printf '"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'
@@%s@@
'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"' nft; nft list ruleset 2>&1 | head -n 600; printf '"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'
@@%s@@
'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"' iptables; iptables -S 2>&1 | head -n 600; printf '"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'
@@%s@@
'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"' iptables_nat; iptables -t nat -S 2>&1 | head -n 300; printf '"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'
@@%s@@
'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"' ip6tables; ip6tables -S 2>&1 | head -n 200; printf '"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'
@@%s@@
'"'"'"'"'"'"'"'"' ufw; ufw status verbose 2>&1'"'"' kanareika 
'
